# DecorImport

Flora, furniture, walls and doors imported from other SS14 forks and SS13 codebases. Each sprite's source and licence are in its
RSI `meta.json`. `Resources/Maps/_WF/DecorImport/` has one showcase map each for flora, furniture and walls.
